WARNING: This file is NOT where your settings are stored.
This file is only used to display the settings in the game.
The file you are looking for is 'settings.txt' in your saves folder.
If you want to change your settings, edit that file instead.

disasters: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Flight dying in ten suntrails.
showxp: Show exact XP and nutrition status
Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
random med cat: Allow lifebloods to be randomly selected on patrol
Lifebloods can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
fading: Allow dead dragons to fade away
After 2002 moons, dead dragons will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded dragons information
A complete copy of faded dragon save info will be saved in plain-text.
backgrounds: Even with this off, the camp you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
moons and seasons: Displays Flight age and current Flight season on several pages.

deputy: Allow leaders to automatically choose a new secondsight
The Skyclaw Creed rules will be taken into account when choosing a secondsight.
12_moon_graduation: All fledgelings will graduate at 120 moons.
retirement: Dragons will never retire due to a permanent condition
When this setting is off, dragons with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire.
become_mediator: Allow skyclaws and ancients to choose to become silvertounges
Skyclaws and ancientss will have a chance to become silvertounges upon timeskip.

affair: Allow dragons to breed with dragons that aren't their mates
This will allow mated and unmated dragons to have hatchlings with other dragons they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
same sex birth: Allow all dragons to get pregnant despite their gender and all couples to birth hatchlings despite same-sex status.
same sex adoption: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
single parentage: Allow dragons to have hatchlings with an unknown second parent
Allow dragons to have hatchlings with an unknown second biological parent. The dragon will be listed as the only biological parent.
romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
Allows mentors and the dragons they trained to be romantic after they become skyclaws.
first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
Allows dragons with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.

by-status: The Flight will be fed according their status and within the status by age.
younger first: The Flight will be fed according to their age only.
less nutrition first: First the dragons with the lowest nutrition will be fed, afterwards the Flight will be fed according to their status.
hunter first: Firstly the dragon with a hunter skill will be fed, afterwards the Flight will be fed according to their status.
sick/injured first: Firstly the sick and injured dragons will be fed, afterwards the Flight will be fed according to their status.
more experience first: The Flight will be fed according their experience, highest one first.
ration prey: Healthy skyclaws will only eat half of the food they need, even if there is enough for the Flight.

business as usual: The Flight has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
hunting: The Flight will focus on hunting, each working Skyclaw (including secondsight and leader) and each working fledgling will gather additional prey on each suntrailskip.
herb gathering: The Flight will focus on herb gathering, each lifeblood and lifeblood apprentice will gather additional herbs on each suntrailskip due to extra help from the skyclaws.
threaten outsiders: The relationship with dragons outside of the Flight decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from your skyclaws.
seek outsiders: The relationship with dragons outside of the Flight increases as your skyclaws make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
rest and recover: The Flight will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
sabotage other clans: Your silvertounges and skyclaws work together to undermine the other Flights. Only available if you have a working silvertounge. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Flight you target.
aid other clans: Your silvertounges and skyclaws work together to help the other Flights with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working silvertounge. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Flights you target.
raid other clans: Your skyclaws begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each suntrailskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Flights decrease. You will be able to choose which Flights you target.
hoarding: Your skyclaws begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their claws on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each suntrailskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
